name: Anamorphic Corner Billboard
promptTemplate: A forced-perspective anamorphic billboard featuring a {{subject}} with a {{palette}} palette, dynamic {{corner_curvature}} screen structure, protrusion level {{protrusion_scale}}, street ambiance {{street_atmosphere}}, and visible LED matrix {{led_grid_fx}}.

subject.hint: Morph the 3D entity bursting out of the frame

palette.hint: Shift neon reflections and screen illumination

protrusion_scale.hint: Push how far the object pops beyond the corner

street_atmosphere.hint: Toggle crowd shadows and wet asphalt puddle sheens

led_grid_fx.hint: Show the subpixel LED matrix facade

listing.blurb: A giant glossy form bursts from a curved corner LED billboard into the night sky, throwing anamorphic perspective and wet street reflections across the room.
listing.prompt: An anamorphic billboard on a curved corner LED screen above a street: a giant glossy object seems to burst out of the screen's frame in forced perspective -- a wave crashing out of a box, a chrome ball rolling over the edge -- the corner fold of the screen drawn so the illusion holds. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
